emojis.label: us deports people to uganda
emojis.title: US deports eight people 'of African origin' to Uganda
emojis.summary: The Uganda Law Society criticises the deportation, saying it was illegal and "dehumanising".

emojis.label: downed us jet in iran war
emojis.title: Downed U.S. Jet and Missing Crew Member Raise Stakes in War
emojis.summary: The F-15E was the first American warplane shot down by Iran in the five-week war and a crew member is missing. A second U.S. combat plane crashed in the Gulf region and its pilot was rescued, U.S. officials said.

emojis.label: french ship in strait of hormuz
emojis.title: French-owned ship passes through Strait of Hormuz
emojis.summary: It appears to be the first ship owned by a major European firm to go through the strait since the conflict began.

emojis.label: pope washes priests' feet
emojis.title: Pope Leo Returns to Tradition, Washing Priests’ Feet
emojis.summary: Pope Francis washed and kissed the feet of prisoners and refugees. On Thursday, his successor performed the rite of humility and service for priests.

emojis.label: cuba uprising potential
emojis.title: Could There Be a Popular Uprising in Cuba?
emojis.summary: There is no organized opposition on the island because many critics of the regime have fled. But anti-government protests have been growing.
